source.prompt: Instrumental background music for a classic 1990s-style Japanese fantasy role-playing game. The writing and orchestration evoke the golden age of 16-bit console RPG soundtracks (memorable singable lead melody, clear bass line, warm chords, tasteful hall reverb), but the production is high quality, warm and full, recorded with real-sounding instruments. Completely original melody. Final battle against the primordial void king: epic and cosmic; the main theme heard in a minor key, then turning major and triumphant near the end of the loop. Tempo 160 BPM, 4/4 time, key of E minor. Instrumentation: pipe organ and wordless choir intro (no words), fast string ostinato, brass, timpani, driving drums, electric bass. Form: organ and choir intro, furious main section, heroic main-theme quote turning major, back to the furious section. Duration: 120 seconds. Instrumental only: no vocals, no singing, no spoken words, no lyrics. Keep one steady tempo and key from start to finish, no fade-in and no fade-out, no long silences; the last bar leads naturally back into the first bar so the piece loops seamlessly as game background music.
